name: finance
description: Asks before money moves through a payment or banking app (refunds, payouts, transfers, charges, invoices), whatever the request said. Reads are never asked about.

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-refund
smartRules.reason: A refund returns money to a customer. node9 asks before money moves, whatever the request said (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-payout
smartRules.reason: A payout moves the balance to a bank account. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-transfer
smartRules.reason: A transfer moves money between accounts. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-charge
smartRules.reason: This charges a card or captures a payment. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-payment-link
smartRules.reason: This bills someone or creates a link that charges a card. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-subscription
smartRules.reason: A subscription starts or stops recurring charges. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-dispute
smartRules.reason: This answers or concedes a chargeback. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-card
smartRules.reason: This issues a card or changes its limit. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).

smartRules.name: shield:finance:review-withdraw
smartRules.reason: A withdrawal moves money out. node9 asks before money moves (Finance shield).
